code.title: After 'Add another commodity', should the trader come back to Commodity details?
code.question: A trader is on Commodity details and selects 'Add another commodity'. They choose a further species and select 'Save and continue'. Should they come back to Commodity details to enter the new species' number of animals, as they did before? The same question applies to 'Add another commodity' on Identification details.
code.asBuilt: Outside the first run, the trader lands on the Overview and has to reopen the Commodity details task to count the new species. In the first run, the save goes on to the next step, Main import reason. Before this release, this save always went back to Commodity details. The Behaviour Spec says nothing about where this save lands, and the code looks wrong on a plain reading, so the spec was left unchanged until the business answers. On Identification details only 'Add another commodity' is affected; its 'Change' link correctly opens Commodity details.

engineering.title: Plants: Date submitted and Date created show the previous day just after midnight in summer
engineering.label: A defect to fix, not a question
engineering.question: For a plants notification submitted between midnight and 1am in summer time, the confirmation page, Date submitted and Date created show the previous day. Choose Wrong to confirm this is a fault to fix, or Right if you can accept it as it is.
engineering.asBuilt: The tests were widened to accept the previous day for submissions in that hour, so they pass while the dates are wrong. The engineering review lists it as a defect to correct in the service rather than in the tests.

engineering.title: What status should PIMS receive when the health certificate is missing?
engineering.label: Question for the business and the PIMS team
engineering.question: Should PIMS keep receiving 'Submitted', with the missing certificate carried separately, or should the PIMS message format be changed with the PIMS team? Say in your comment which you prefer.
engineering.asBuilt: A live-animals notification submitted without a virus-checked health certificate now goes to PIMS with the status 'Submitted action required'. The agreed PIMS message format does not allow that status, and the 9 October ruling said what PIMS receives would not change.
